description: Electricity, Gas and Water (Hawkesbury City Council) is a dataset listed in Hawkesbury City open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Hawkesbury City Council. This dataset brings together Water, Electricity and Gas data from different suppliers (Origin, ENGIE and Sydney Water), in a normalised format. This dataset is one of the main dataset used in the Sustainability Performance dashboard (Utilities section), along with the Carbon Inventory dataset. Coverage: Hawkesbury, New South Wales. The portal files it under Environmental Protection. Its keywords are utilities, energy, electricity, gas, water, Sustainability & Net Zero dashboard. The portal shows 31,812 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-hawkesbury-nsw-gov-au-portal.
